title: IFRS 9 Credit Migration Matrix Generator
description: Generate cohort transition matrices across credit rating bands using embedded benchmark matrices by asset class. Calculate IFRS 9 Stage 1/2/3 classification, lifetime PD curves via Markov chain, macro overlay, and ECL stage allocation. Outputs the transition matrix, cumulative PD schedule, Markdown IFRS 9 disclosure memo, and AP2 JSON ECL model parameters. Client-side. Zero PII.

macro_overlay_factor.description: PiT uplift multiplier e.g. 1.35 = 35% increase. 1.0 = no overlay.

portfolio_counts.description: Count of counterparties at each rating band [AAA,AA,A,BBB,BB,B,CCC] for portfolio stage distribution. Optional — set all to 0 to skip.

mcp_tool_definition.name: generate_credit_migration_matrix
mcp_tool_definition.description: Generates IFRS 9 ECL parameters using a Markov chain credit migration model. Selects an embedded benchmark annual transition matrix by asset class, raises it to the power n for lifetime PD, applies a forward-looking macro overlay, and classifies the exposure into IFRS 9 Stage 1, 2, or 3 based on SICR triggers (rating notch deterioration and PD doubling test). Returns cumulative PD schedule, 12-month ECL, lifetime ECL, and the applied ECL amount. Use for IFRS 9 impairment provisioning and disclosure memos.
